figures.caption: Table 1: Summary of synthetic experimental results.
Figure 1: Recovery distribution across 25 independent datasets. Pairwise parameters cluster tightly around truth; hyperedge weight shows systematic −22% bias.
Figure 2: Phase transition in spectral radius as hyperedge strength increases. ρ(A) crosses ρ = 1 at about 1.24 times the predicted critical strength.
Figure 3: Falsifiability test. Left: likelihood gain. Right: BIC-based model selection.
Figure 4: Bias ablation across kernel decay rates. The bias is non-monotonic, minimised at intermediate β, ruling out the simple temporal-overlap hypothesis.

Figure 5: Real data analysis (CRCNS ret-1). Left: spike raster of 7 neurons. Centre: inferred pairwise interaction matrix. Right: candidate hyperedge weights with model comparison (∆L = +20.6, BIC diff = −8.1).
